futureCapabilities: Every Strategy other than Long Stock, and the remaining ten canonical Strategy seeds (D8, D9, D11, D12).
Position recording, Executions, Positions, Lots, FIFO Lot Matches, fees, realized P&L, and Planned becoming Open (D3).
Daily Review, Mark entry, Expected Mark Status, and Stop-Discipline deviation reconciliation (D4).
Corrections: Replace, Void, Rebuild, Correction Footprint, View history and audit history UI (D15, D16).
Close Reason, Abandonment Reason, Close Review and abandonPlan; no close or abandonment at D2 (D6).
Management revisions: D2 freezes original management only and offers no revision (D14).
Terminal Disposition, valuation, marked P&L, Overrun and Expiration Payoff: no Marks or disposing facts exist at D2.
The remaining five of seven Journal Entry Types and five of seven Sources, and the full seedDefaults manifest (D17).
Backup, Restore, migration of older Workspaces, installation and update (D7, D20, D21, D22).
Any latency claim; D2 asserts boundedness only and no timing statement (AC-PERF-001 is unowned).
